title: Keep a bounded cause for unconfirmed own-run wait failures
outcome: An uncertain host-wait result retains an enumerated non-sensitive cause so operators can distinguish transport, timeout, response and acknowledgement failures.
acceptance: results.hostWait retains a bounded enumerated cause for timeout, transport failure, invalid response/status and invalid wait acknowledgement while preserving the public test-run-wait-unconfirmed outcome.
Summary/receipt prints only the enumerated cause and existing sanitized diagnostics; no raw exception or host body is exposed, and one-shot/no-retry behavior remains verified.
